grain: one official NFL Draft selection keyed by draft year and overall pick

riskFindings.interpretation: The pre-2015 mapped population uses birth-county fallback rather than verified high-school county, so cross-era county comparisons do not use one stable geography definition.
riskFindings.control: Default the product to the 2015-2026 verified-high-school view and label the all-years fallback view as mixed evidence.

riskFindings.interpretation: Later-round picks have lower location coverage, so mapped-only analyses can overrepresent earlier selections.
riskFindings.control: Show coverage after every filter and never treat unresolved records as zero.

riskFindings.interpretation: Coverage varies by listed position, partly because source position taxonomies change across eras.
riskFindings.control: Expose selection-level coverage and avoid claims that position differences represent true geographic production without adjustment.

riskFindings.interpretation: Within mature draft classes, players with a Pro Bowl have higher county coverage than other selections, so mapped-only outcome summaries can overrepresent successful players.
riskFindings.control: Label the outcome window, disclose the coverage gradient, and present county outcome counts as descriptive rather than causal.
